messages.subject: Statistical Validity Test
parts:
I’m mocked up a statistical testing framework on the branch https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/tree/feature/stat_valid_test.
Give it a try with

mkfast test/stat-validity/models/gauss_iid
mkfast test/stat-validity/models/gauss_corr
mkfast test/stat-validity/models/funnel

Note that the gaussians are fast but the funnel will take around 30 minutes (if not longer).

Thoughts? Model recommendations?

Dan, everything runs in src/test/test-models/compiled/stat-validity/ but maybe we
should tweak it to run in test/stat-validity or something?
